periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented at an oblique angle, approximately 40 degrees relative to the median facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoid morphology with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering and elongation observed toward the lower anterior margin near the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Posterior boundary of the band exhibits a shallow V-shaped curvature directed toward the tail.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 30% of the visible torso length along the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is approximately twice the basal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are smoothly rounded and semicircular.

other_distinctive_markers: The fur on the hindquarters and lower dorsal region displays a distinct brownish-sepia coloration rather than a standard black pigment.
